message.name: IntraPositionMovementQueryResponseV01
message.definition: The IntraPositionMovementQueryResponse message is sent from a settlement infrastructure to an account owner/requestor to provide all intra-position movement instructions satisfying the selection criteria, as defined within the query, returning current attributes and latest status.|The message may also be used to: |- re-send a message sent by the account owner to the account servicer (the sub-function of the message is "Duplicate") |- provide a third party with a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy") |- re-send to a third party a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy Duplicate").

rules.name: ReportIdentificationRule
rules.text: If the report has multiple pages, then the ReportIdentification must remain the same through all the pages. It is a unique number to the report.|Two reports of the same type sent one after the other to the same receiver in relation to the same safekeeping account must have different report identifications. For example, a daily report sent on day 1 would have ReportIdentification 001, on day 2, 002, etc.

rules.name: AdditionalReasonInforrmationRule
rules.text: The AdditionalReasonInformation element must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed.

rules.name: PendingToFailingRule
rules.text: A pending transaction (PEND) becomes a failing transaction (PENF) on the settlement date instructed in the message, during the end of day reporting.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: PlaceOfListingRule
rules.text: If PlaceOfListing is used and an ISO 10383 MIC exists for the market to be identified, the ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (MIC) must be used.

rules.name: AdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if FinancialInstrumentAttributeAdditionalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: WithLinkageRule
rules.text: If Code WITH is used, then the one or more instruction which are linked become bound and which must be executed together. Even if one single transactions/instructions/notifications can not be executed, then all the other transactions/instructions/notifications must also be kept pending. Therefore the use of code WITH must be limited to combine up to 2 or 3 transactions/instructions/notifications.

rules.name: ShortLongNumberRule
rules.text: ShortNumber must contain the FIN message type number of the linked message. LongNumber must contain the XML message identifier of the linked message.

rules.name: EventTypeRule
rules.text: The use of a specific corporate action event type code is allowed only if this specific event triggers a securities movement as per the Event Interpretation Grid published by the Securities Market Practice Group (SMPG).|The corporate action event indicator code OTHR must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate.|The corporate action event indicator code CHAN must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change.|The corporate action event indicator code REDM must only be used when the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the holders.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: NoAccountOwnerTransactionIdentificationRule
rules.text: If no reference is available for the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification, for example, the transaction was sent by fax, then the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification must be NONREF.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountRule
rules.text: SafekeepingAccount must be present or Movement(*)/SafekeepingAccount must be present, but not both.

rules.name: AccountOwnerRule
rules.text: AccountOwner must be present or Movement(*)/AccountOwner must be present, but not both.

rules.name: StatusAndReasonRule
rules.text: StatusAndReason must be present or Movement(*)/StatusAndReason must be present, but not both.

rules.name: ActivityIndicatorYesRule
rules.text: If ReportGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is equal to Yes (true or 1) then Movements must be present.

rules.name: ActivityIndicatorNoRule
rules.text: If ReportGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is equal to No (false or 0) then Movements must be absent.

rules.name: QueryTypeFullRule
rules.text: If ReportGeneralDetails/QueryType is equal to Full, then Movements(*)/Movement/MovementDetails must be present.

rules.name: QueryTypeStatusRule
rules.text: If ReportGeneralDetails/QueryType is equal to Status, then Movements(*)/Movement/MovementDetails must be absent.
